description: A shell script providing CLI utilities to manage OCI containers and Dobby specs, including starting, stopping, listing, and executing commands inside containers.

methods.name: start_container_from_bundle
methods.description: Starts an OCI container from a specified bundle path or name, extracting tarballs if necessary.

methods.name: start_container_from_spec
methods.description: Starts a container using a Dobby specification JSON file.

methods.name: stop_container
methods.description: Stops a running container by container ID.

methods.name: get_container_info
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specific container.

methods.name: get_container_state
methods.description: Gets the current state of a container.

methods.name: execute_command
methods.description: Executes arbitrary commands inside a container with options.

methods.name: ocicontainer_help
methods.description: Displays help information for available commands.
